title: Missing receipt Storage object hung /review/[id] indefinitely
goal: app/(app)/review/[id]/page.tsx awaited getDocumentPreviewUrl/getDocumentPreviewText inside the page's single Promise.all with no error handling. When a receipt's storage_paths pointed at an object no longer in Storage, the whole request never resolved to either the page or its error boundary.
in_scope: Catch the per-file document/text preview fetch failure and degrade to the existing 'No preview available.' fallback instead of letting it hang the page
out_of_scope: Any other part of the review-detail flow (line-item review, commit action)
acceptance: The document/text preview fetch in app/(app)/review/[id]/page.tsx degrades to the existing 'No preview available.' fallback on failure instead of an unhandled rejection stalling the whole page; reproduced pre-fix (60s+, never resolved) and confirmed resolved post-fix (~4s, renders correctly).
invariants: Line-item review and commit functionality on this page must be unaffected
